reports.text:
Twenty years ago I stood in the rain outside the Ferry Building and waited for one man to step over the puddle.

January 12, 2006. I called it Ode to Cartier-Bresson, after his 1932 shot of a man leaping a puddle behind the Gare Saint-Lazare.

The F Market car 1057 was rolling in https://t.co/0oTVfFpLYg

reports.author: 911sf_org
reports.text: In 2023, homeowners sued the City, SFPUC, and DPW for negligence, nuisance, and inverse condemnation. The City filled the Pierce Street Outfall with concrete in May 2021—a relief valve that previously diverted excess storm overflow into the Bay. Marina Green flooded again today. https://t.co/GliMFCiUiy

reports.author: daniel_w_owens
reports.text:
The parts of the Mission that flooded today are sitting atop a large watershed that used to be Mission Creek.

Street drains and sewage pipes go into the same box. Heavy rains fill up the box. Then, rainwater and sewage (yes, sewage) come to the surface.

Thank you for your time. https://t.co/kpJVUEk82S
reports.summary: Flooded streets in Mission District with cars driving through water
